title: Late-Fee Rate Card by Payment Record (Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements)
content:
**Rate card.** On an overdue invoice of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement, the starting late-fee rate follows the agreement's record of late fees charged in the late-fee record window: the 12 calendar months up to and including the fee date, each late fee placed by the date it was charged. Every late fee entry on the agreement's invoices counts, whichever invoice it was charged on.

| Late fees charged on the agreement in the 12-month window | Starting late-fee rate |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2.5 percent |
| exactly 1 | 2.0 percent |
| none | the tier's late-payment fee percentage |

The late-fee rate on the fee starts from the rate in the right-hand column, in percent of the unpaid amount past due.

### Boundary rows

| Late fees in the window | Starting rate |
|---|---|
| 0 | the tier's late-payment fee percentage |
| 1 | 2.0 percent |
| 2 | 2.5 percent (the repeat-fee count of 2 is reached) |
| 3 or more | 2.5 percent |

### Reading the window (hypothetical dates)

For a fee date of 15 September, the window covers the 12 calendar months up to and including 15 September; a late fee charged before that window does not count. An agreement whose record shows late fees charged on 3 February and 28 June of the same year, and none before the window, has 2 late fees in the window, and its starting late-fee rate is 2.5 percent.
